cohort: The study included all singleton births in Victoria, Australia, between 2009 and 2020, totaling 860,042 pregnancies, of which 100,856 were complicated by diabetes in pregnancy.
finding: Gestational diabetes was associated with a lower overall risk of stillbirth, potentially due to increased monitoring and earlier iatrogenic delivery, while preexisting diabetes was associated with a higher overall risk of stillbirth, particularly for macrosomic fetuses in the >97th centile.
birth_weight: Birth weight centile (<10th or >97th centile) and macrosomic fetuses (>97th centile) were analyzed.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth (median 38.7 weeks vs. 39.4 for non-diabetic) and stillbirth rate across gestational age were examined.
